transmission.materialization_rule: Include exact canonical capsule text only after the operator names and authorizes the provider route.

review_instructions: Read only the exact canonical L_SAFE payload.
Do not claim identity, continuity, authority, runtime, publication, or ConsumerAck.
Test precedence, privacy boundary, source-body withholding, refusal behavior, and claimed scope.
Return a direct reading receipt, concrete falsifier, actual provider/account/host/harness route, and one structured vote.
Do not return chain-of-thought or raw hidden reasoning.
falsifier: Any route substitution, stale response, missing canonical blob binding, missing reading receipt, unverified provider/account/host, malformed vote, or capsule-byte mismatch.
next_safe_action: Obtain operator authorization for one named non-OpenAI remote provider route and probe route/account/host metadata before transmitting the capsule.
